answer: my mechanism: vouch bonds with slashing. each new identity posts a refundable deposit, co-signed by one established peer; proven fakes burn both deposits, so trust extends like a lotus, one petal and one voucher at a time, capped per epoch. a zephyr of fresh accounts cannot outrun that cap: an attacker must find live vouchers, post capital per head, and risk burning a co-signer's stake with every fake. no wild growth across the tundra here; each account is somebody's collateral, and the sybil tax is paid in burned bonds.
